title: Junior Financial Advisor – Client Service
description: Support senior advisors with client onboarding, account maintenance, and paperwork. Answer client calls, update CRM, and assist with meeting preparation. No direct client ownership. Training program included.

title: Financial Advisor – Associate to Advisor Track
description: Join the Merrill Lynch Advisor Development Program. Series 7 and 66 required. Work with an established team managing $500M+ AUM serving HNW clients ($1M+). After 12-18 months on the team, transition to your own book of business with mentorship, leads, and firm referral pipeline. Competitive grid payout. Base + bonus during transition.

title: Wealth Management Associate
description: Small RIA with $300M AUM. Primary duties: client meeting prep, portfolio rebalancing, CRM updates, and answering client service calls. Owner is looking for long-term succession but timeline is 5–7 years. No leads or referral pipeline currently.

title: VP Financial Consultant
description: Inbound-driven model. Work with warm leads from Fidelity's 40M+ existing customers. Handle rollover conversations, financial planning, and managed account solutions. Target clients: $250K–$2M investable. Series 7 and 66 required. Competitive salary + bonus + equity. Strong internal promotion track to Senior VP.

title: Financial Planner – Service Team
description: Provide financial planning support to existing Vanguard clients via phone and video. No prospecting. Scripted planning conversations. Series 7, 66 required. Salary only, no commission. Remote work, not NYC-based.
